arguments.command:
python -c "
from funcy.decorators import decorator

# When decorator is used without parentheses on a function that has more than one arg,
# it should return a decorator factory (decorator_fab)
@decorator
def my_dec(call, x):
    return call() + x

print('Type:', type(my_dec))
print('Callable:', callable(my_dec))

# This should work as a decorator fab
dec = my_dec(42)
print('dec type:', type(dec))
"
